question: By what oblation do enemies perish within twenty-one days?
premises: Oblations are performed with substances mixed with pungent oil.
The ritual effect unfolds over twenty-one days.
Enemies are the targets of this oblation.
inference: Oblations mixed with pungent oil cause enemies to die within twenty-one days.
plain_english: And from oblations mixed with pungent oil, enemies die within twenty-one days.
